g.text: 12 V input - two GPU 8-pin OR one EPS 8-pin

g.desc: 12 V input - two GPU 8-pin OR one EPS 8-pin

g.text: Choose GPU pair OR EPS with a break-before-make selector rated >=30 A, >=24 VDC. Do not switch under load.

g.desc: Choose GPU pair OR EPS with a break-before-make selector rated >=30 A, >=24 VDC. Do not switch under load.

g.text: GPU pair MUST come from the same PSU. Both GPU connectors required for full output. Do not combine separate PSUs.

g.desc: GPU pair MUST come from the same PSU. Both GPU connectors required for full output. Do not combine separate PSUs.

g.text: Connector pin numbering is the electrical interface: verify keying, mating face and selected manufacturer drawing before layout.
